environment.description: ECS Fargate service in the same VPC topology. The RDS PostgreSQL instance enforces IAM database authentication (rds_iam extension enabled, password auth disabled via rds.force_ssl and iam-only pg_hba.conf). The ECS task role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:policy/DataPlaneRestriction) that includes an explicit Deny on 'rds-db:connect' for any dbuser other than 'app_readonly'. The 'app_readonly' PostgreSQL role is granted SELECT only on the 'products' table with no access to pg_catalog system tables, information_schema, or any other schema. Row-level security is enabled on 'products' with a policy restricting visibility to rows where 'is_active = true'. Additionally, the RDS instance parameter group sets 'log_statement=all' and 'statement_timeout=3000' (3 seconds). The ECS task's IAM role trust policy restricts sts:AssumeRole to the specific ECS task definition ARN via condition key aws:SourceArn.

config.db_privileges: SELECT ON products WHERE is_active = true (RLS enforced)
config.pg_catalog_access: REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA pg_catalog FROM app_readonly
config.information_schema_access: REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA information_schema FROM app_readonly
